question: The Prime Minister Atmanirbhar Swasth Bharat Yojana was announced in which year's Union Budget?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021-22.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** Prime Minister Atmanirbhar Swasth Bharat Yojana (PMASBY) **was announced in the Indian Union Budget for the fiscal year **2021-22.**
 
• This scheme aligns with the central government's initiative towards achieving** 'Atmanirbhar Bharat'** (Self-Reliant India).
 
• The purpose of this scheme is to develop capacities of** health care systems, develop institutions, and create a network** that provides universal access to **public health services.**
 
• The scheme has an outlay of around** Rs. 64,180 Cr,** which is intended to be spread over **six years.**
 
• It is said to have a significant impact on the rural and urban health scenarios in the country by fulfilling the **needs of healthcare systems.**
 
• With the help of PMASBY, the government aims to** detect and cure** emerging diseases at the local level, thereby **strengthening the entire health care system in India.**
